title: Orange image levels statistics (whole 8-bit Mono8 image; version 1 DRAFT)
description: DRAFT 2026-11-02, shared by the empty-background capture descriptor (cameras[].statistics) and the per-camera image-levels check, so recordings carry one shape. Computed over every pixel of one 8-bit Mono8 image at the native recorded raster, no ROI. Exact definitions, so a reader can recompute every value to the integer from the image: count(L) is the number of pixels at level L; pixel_count = sum of count(L) = width x height; saturated_fraction = count(255) / pixel_count; zero_fraction = count(0) / pixel_count; mean = sum(L x count(L)) / pixel_count; fractions and mean are rounded half away from zero to 8 and 3 decimals. Percentile pK uses k = 10, 50, 500, 950, 990, 999 for p01, p05, p50, p95, p99, p999: rank = ceil(k x pixel_count / 1000), computed in integer arithmetic; pK is the smallest level L whose cumulative count (sum of count(0..L)) is at least rank (nearest rank, so always an exact grey level). p999 is there because p99 is already 255 on a near-clipped background (2026-11-01 setup: about 3.4% of background pixels at 255 in one frame).

saturation_value.description: The level counted as saturated, declared rather than implied.

pixel_count.description: Pixels measured (width x height); the denominator of the fractions.

saturated_fraction.description: Fraction of pixels equal to saturation_value.
